Starting by reading the advisory and changelog files, and discovering the deploy tools.

Now I'll get the live status of every service.

Classification is done. Six environments need the fix, so I'm building those commits now.

loyalty-svc failed to build, so I'm not deploying anything to it. The other five go out now.

The HF-2291 rollout is only partly done. `loyalty-svc@prod` still has no fix, because its build failed.

All 15 production environments are in `/app/hotfix-report.json`, and I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `partial`. I didn't re-check the live releases after deploying. The report relies on each deploy call's response.

| Result | Environments |
|---|---|
| Deployed | `cart-api@prod` and `webhooks-out@prod` now run `2a2a83f` (4.3). `checkout-svc@prod-eu`, `reco-engine@prod` and `session-gw@prod-eu` now run `aec3b0e` (4.2). |
| Already fixed | `checkout-svc@prod`, `profile-api@prod`, `session-gw@prod`, `webhooks-out@prod-eu` |
| Not affected | `admin-console@prod` (on 4.0), plus `catalog-api`, `geo-svc`, `mail-relay` and `pricing-api` on `prod` (not on the advisory's list) |
| Build failed | `loyalty-svc@prod`: building `1f173c7` for `release/4.1` failed, so I deployed nothing there. It still runs `8d81b0a`. |

`cart-api@prod` was on `f45bc24`, which sits just below the revert of the fix in the 4.3 changelog. That is why it counted as unfixed even though 4.3 later reapplied the fix.

I didn't touch `staging`, roll anything back, or repeat any deploy.
